name: Eylem Başlatma Gecikmesi
definition: Ne yapacağını biliyor ama ilk adımı atamama. Niyet → eylem boşluğu. 'Bakayım' derken başkası bitiriyor.
symptoms: İçten içe biliyorsun ama hareket yok

mechanisms.primary: Intention-behavior gap — goal intention without implementation intention
secondary: ADHD-I: initiation difficulties as behavioral consequence of inattention

research_sources.finding: II closes intention-behavior gap. d=0.65. Strategic automaticity: cue triggers response without conscious deliberation.
If-then statements speed up responses to PM targets in everyday life. Strengthened cue-intention association.
CBT for ADHD-I with behavioral activation: d=0.65 activation subscale. Initiation + termination strategies. > standard CBT.
14 sessions: organizing + initiating + procrastination + mindfulness. Medium effect on inattention d=0.55-0.65.
Shrink tasks to first physical step. Schedule it. Reduce friction. Add cues. Reward completion.
63 repetitions: cue detection up, interference eliminated. Action becomes automatic with repetition.
Including situational cues in intention thought → stimulus-response learning → automatic triggering.
Experts: first considered option is usually viable. No option comparison needed. Pattern → action.
Physical presence of another person facilitates task initiation for ADHD. Reduces activation threshold.
Central executive training improves WM and go/no-go (d=0.84). Mixed for stop-signal.
Compress 3-second rule to 1 second for competitive contexts. First sound within 1 second.
Phone/hand movement + mouth open simultaneously. Motor initiation bypasses cognitive deliberation.
Multicomponent interventions best for inhibitory control g=0.63 and sustained attention g=0.95 in pediatric ADHD.

solutions.name: Implementation Intentions
solutions.protocol: 'X olursa → Y yaparım' — spesifik durum + spesifik fiziksel eylem. Sabah 3 plan.

solutions.name: 1 Saniye + Fiziksel Tetik
solutions.protocol: Soru geldi → telefonu/elini hareket ettir + ağzı aç. Aynı anda. 'Bakıyorum—'

solutions.name: İlk Ben Antrenmanı
solutions.protocol: Günde 3 bilinçli 'ilk ben' eylemi. Refleks kası oluştur.

solutions.name: Behavioral Activation (İlk Adım)
solutions.protocol: Görevi en küçük fiziksel adıma böl. 'Garsona seslen' → 'Ağzımı aç ve B harfi söyle'

solutions.name: Ağız Önce Protokolü
solutions.protocol: Karar vermeden konuşmaya başla. Beyin cümleyi tamamlar.

solutions.name: Tekrar → Otomatik
solutions.protocol: Aynı durumu 5-10 kez tekrarla → eylem otomatikleşir. Aidat sorusu × 5 = refleks.

daily_protocol.during_day: 3x ilk ben + 1 sn kuralı + fiziksel tetik
daily_protocol.evening: Kaç kez niyet var ama hareket yok? Hangi if-then işe yaradı?

weekly: İlk hareket eden sen oldun mu sayısı

interactions.note: II = en güçlü kanıtlı eylem başlatma aracı.
